dashboard.initial:
Create one realistic production-quality desktop application UI design image for AutoFlow, a Chinese local automation resource manager. Use case ui-mockup. This is the DASHBOARD page in a coherent three-page premium design system. Target 1440 x 1024, landscape, full-bleed app interface only, straight-on, crisp high-resolution typography, no device bezel, no perspective mockup, no surrounding poster, no design annotations. Current date 2026-09-12; no need to display date.

REFERENCE: attached current dashboard screenshot is the source of existing product navigation, six resource types, four work entrances and AutoFlow logo. Preserve these capabilities and overall page hierarchy while refining proportions, details and finishes. Do not reproduce the purple OS capture indicator/titlebar.

ART DIRECTION: Quiet, exceptionally well-crafted professional desktop tool. Warm-gray finely grained paper canvas #F3F1EC. The paper is a subtle tactile microtexture, almost imperceptible at reading distance. A faint broad paper compression / pressed fold light variation ONLY in the far top-right unused background edge, never crossing text. Panels are smooth milky porcelain #FBFAF7, hairline warm-gray rims, restrained small contact shadows. Frosted ivory header with restrained translucency, not blur on text. No crumpled kraft paper, distressed edges, sepia filter, glassmorphism everywhere, glossy plastic, neon, gradients behind text, huge decorative 3D objects, or thick borders.

DESIGN SYSTEM: clay brown #8D4E2F primary/selected state, blue #476B91 browser, teal #31756F proxy, muted violet #75618A models; ink #34322E and muted #625E57. Module colors are small accents, not full-card gradients. 16px cards, 10px controls, 40px control height. Beautiful readable Chinese modern system sans, page title 28px semibold, 16px subhead, 14px body, 12px secondary, optical alignment, generous purposeful spacing. Do not exaggerate letter spacing in Chinese.

ICON DESIGN: a unified set of six bespoke-looking precise duotone symbols, recognizably based on a rounded-line icon family. Each resource icon is centered in a softly inset 44px squared tile with 12px radius. One shallow frosted ceramic colored layer, one crisp darker outline, subtle top-light, tiny contact shadow. Browser=window; proxies=network connection; proxy group=connected stacked nodes; kernel=microchip; provider=plug connection; model=layered inference cube. Six distinguishable symbols, consistent stroke width and visual weight. All small action icons remain flat precise line icons, do NOT turn tiny icons into illustrations. Reuse the attached AutoFlow two-layer clay mark.

LAYOUT: Header 78px with logo AutoFlow at left, nav 总览 selected with short clay underline, 浏览器配置, 代理管理, 模型管理. Right gear 设置, divider, green status dot and 本地服务正常. Main content max-width about 1220px, left/right 60px, top 44px. Page heading 总览, subtitle 集中查看本机资源，并进入日常管理工作。 No huge greeting hero, no charts or invented tasks.
Section 资源概况. Six resource cards in a 3-column by 2-row grid, refined 20px gaps, each about 162px high, icon upper left, label aligned beside or below, prominent number, short description:
浏览器配置 / 12 / 个全局配置模板
已启用代理 / 8 / 个代理出口已启用
代理组 / 3 / 个本地代理组
已安装内核 / 2 / 个浏览器内核
模型供应商 / 4 / 个供应商
模型 / 18 / 个已配置模型
These are illustrative demo counts, not live claims.
Below section 工作入口 with four compact broad navigation rows in a 2x2 grid: 管理浏览器配置 with 维护浏览器身份、内核与代理绑定; 管理代理出口 with 维护代理连接与本地代理组; 管理模型资源 with 连接供应商并维护模型目录; 查看本地设置 with 管理工作区、应用偏好与诊断. Small cohesive duotone icon at left and chevron at far right. Show first entry in a restrained hover state with subtle blue-tinted edge, other entries neutral; no cursor, no motion trails. Static stats must not look like primary buttons.
Keep all important contents within viewport, breathing room at bottom, no oversized whitespace and no heavy ornamental illustration. Let craft be visible in texture, precise icons, spacing, thin highlights, alignment and hierarchy. EXACT Chinese labels above. Produce only this one polished page image.
dashboard.revision:
EDIT this AutoFlow dashboard mockup to fix two critical design defects and finish its bespoke module icon system. Target same landscape 1440x1024 app-only composition. Keep the existing Chinese navigation, logo, page title, 3x2 six-stat-card hierarchy, four work entrances, fine warm paper texture and crisp typography.

MANDATORY CHANGE 1: Completely REMOVE the entire white horizontal empty-state notice that currently reads 还没有已配置的资源，可从下方工作入口开始。 The resource counts are nonzero, so this notice is wrong. Close its former vertical gap cleanly by moving the resource cards and work entrances up. Rebalance whitespace at bottom, do not replace this notice with another notice, hero or decorative object.

MANDATORY CHANGE 2: The resource icons MUST be COLORED BY MODULE, not all brown. Make the icon assets feel designed for AutoFlow, tactile duotone geometry with a frosted translucent inner colored plane and a crisp dark outline:
- 浏览器配置 and 管理浏览器配置: muted BLUE window glyph #476B91 on pale blue #EAF0F7 tile.
- 已安装内核: muted BLUE microchip glyph #476B91 on pale blue #EAF0F7 tile. Distinct from the window.
- 已启用代理, 代理组, 管理代理出口: muted TEAL #31756F on pale mint #E6F1EE tile. Proxy glyph is connected networking points, group is stacked connected network layers.
- 模型供应商, 模型, 管理模型资源: muted VIOLET #75618A on pale mauve #F0EBF5 tile. Provider a neat connecting plug; model a precisely layered cube with one softly translucent face. Distinct glyphs.
- 设置 stays neutral clay.
All SIX statistic icons have visible subtle duotone fills AND outlines, extremely consistent visual mass, 24px actual glyph inside 44px soft-square tile. No icon brown except settings and AutoFlow brand. No primary saturated blue or neon.
Keep the main surfaces creamy smooth #FBFAF7, canvas finely grained #F3F1EC. No texture on text. App still warm, color added only in icons. Retain the subtle hover tint on first work entrance but use a muted blue hairline not a bright blue focus box. Preserve all numbers: 12,8,3,2,4,18. Do not add extra features, charts, buttons, badges, animations, illustration, or new text.
The result should visibly improve bespoke icon finish and quiet sophistication. It must be immediately apparent that browser icons are blue, proxy icons teal, model icons mauve. Produce only the revised single image.
